tickets.subject: Friday export issue - update from our side
tickets.body: Following up on the Friday export failure from June, which never fully resolved - we've since set up a manual trigger reminder for ourselves each Friday morning as a backstop, so it's not causing any real disruption anymore. Also wanted to flag that the alert notifying us of export failures doesn't seem to fire either, which is really how we noticed the pattern in the first place rather than any warning from the platform. Comparing notes with Dashlume periodically but no decisions made; no urgency needed on either point.
